src-e225fbaca658ecf5.title: Recognized Neighborhood Associations and Coalitions

scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: City of Albuquerque AGIS / Office of Neighborhood Coordination recognized associations and coalitions.
scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: Rendered map depicts named Albuquerque neighborhood associations and local coalitions, their boundaries and areas outside City limits, including Downtown, Barelas, North Valley and the district coalitions.
scope_assessment.abqinfo_public_information_value: Address search and mapped civic organizations help readers identify local association geography for City participation and development-review issues.
scope_assessment.general_context_exclusion_test: This maps specific recognized Albuquerque civic organizations and their relation to City geography; it is not generic contextual mapping or incidental regional data. The website directory serves a separate organization-access function.
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: The actual rendered application provides meaningful Albuquerque civic geography and a working address-search and legend interface. It complements the association website directory and existing City reference maps without duplicating a separate existing application entry. One live City map entry gives readers useful neighborhood context without creating a copied roster, static snapshot or new page.

quality_assessment.document_function: Live City civic-reference map of recognized neighborhood associations and coalitions.
quality_assessment.substantive_content: Rendered labeled association polygons and coalition outlines; legend identifies recognized associations, eight coalition categories and areas outside City limits.
quality_assessment.durable_public_usefulness: Helps residents connect addresses and neighborhoods with City-recognized civic organizations and participation geography.
quality_assessment.information_density: A complete labeled citywide map with search, zoom, information and legend controls presents meaningful neighborhood organization geography.
quality_assessment.unique_information: Mapped recognized association and coalition geography complements website access in the ONC directory; no exact app or equivalent dedicated entry exists in the baseline content.
quality_assessment.rationale: The actual map renders recognizable Albuquerque neighborhood boundaries and coalition geography. Its address search and legend operate successfully in isolated installed desktop Chrome. This provides substantive civic reference value alongside the directory, while one live link avoids redundant association entries or an invented archive.

src-e225fbaca658ecf5.limitations: Address search for 1 Civic Plaza NW returned a local result and zoomed the map. Legend and information controls work. A tested map click did not expose association attributes; publication makes no promise about popup fields. No account or sign-in required, no page errors observed. Data are a maintained service, not an archived static snapshot or certified boundary determination.
src-e225fbaca658ecf5.description: Maps City-recognized neighborhood associations and coalitions, with address search and a legend. This maintained civic reference shows organization geography; it is not a legal boundary determination.
src-e225fbaca658ecf5.duplicate_review: Exact URL/app ID absent in baseline; existing generic map library/demographic geography links are different resources. One canonical entry per new resource with internal cross-references only.

src-26d17a967fcc771c.title: Neighborhood Association Websites

scope_assessment.geographic_institutional_scope: City Office of Neighborhood Coordination recognized Albuquerque neighborhood associations.
scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: The actual directory links websites submitted by named recognized Albuquerque associations and coalitions, including Barelas, Downtown, Nob Hill and neighborhood organizations throughout the City.
scope_assessment.abqinfo_public_information_value: Provides a concise gateway to neighborhood organizations participating in City civic and development processes, complementing the existing ONC task-force and facilitated-meetings records.
scope_assessment.general_context_exclusion_test: The actual resource identifies recognized local organizations and directs readers to their own sites; it is substantive Albuquerque civic participation information, not general municipal context, unrelated jurisdiction or transactional paperwork.
scope_assessment.substantive_rationale: The maintained City directory materially helps readers locate recognized local neighborhood organizations and their association websites. This is a current civic reference adjacent to existing neighborhood participation and development-review materials. One live directory entry provides useful access without copying a changing roster or creating redundant association entries.

quality_assessment.document_function: Maintained official ONC directory linking submitted websites of City-recognized neighborhood associations.
quality_assessment.substantive_content: Rendered named local association website links and contacts, with explicit submitted-site limitation, independent association maintenance and HOA exclusion.
quality_assessment.durable_public_usefulness: Directs readers to recognized neighborhood-level civic organizations for neighborhood issues and participation in City processes.
quality_assessment.information_density: One organized directory provides direct access to numerous named associations instead of copying an unstable roster into ABQInfo.
quality_assessment.unique_information: Organization website access complements mapped association geography and the existing task-force and facilitated-meeting policy references.
quality_assessment.rationale: The rendered maintained City directory directly connects readers with recognized local civic organizations. Its explicit website-submission and HOA limitations are retained in the concise entry. Associations maintain their own sites, so ABQInfo links the directory once rather than publishing an unverified roster or duplicating individual organizations.

src-26d17a967fcc771c.limitations: Directory is limited to submitted websites, not all recognized associations; HOA websites excluded. Individual association sites are maintained independently and are not individually endorsed or freshly audited by this publication.
src-26d17a967fcc771c.description: The City Office of Neighborhood Coordination links websites submitted by recognized neighborhood associations. Associations maintain their own sites; the directory excludes HOA websites.
src-26d17a967fcc771c.duplicate_review: Exact URL/app ID absent in baseline; existing generic map library/demographic geography links are different resources. One canonical entry per new resource with internal cross-references only.
